summary: Touch Dynamic manufactures POS hardware — touchscreen computers (e.g. Pulse Ion), kiosks, mobile POS, rugged Android/Windows tablets, and peripherals (receipt printers, cash drawers) — marketed to restaurants (including QSR/fast casual), retail, healthcare, casino, grocery, convenience store, and school cafeteria segments, with an emphasis on domestic (US) manufacturing and OEM/private-branding programs.

Founded in 2001 and headquartered in South Plainfield, New Jersey (with an additional Houston, TX location), Touch Dynamic is ISO 9001:2015 certified, states it has completed over 1,200 projects across 70,000+ square feet of facilities, and received a 2026 RSPA VAE Silver award plus a New Jersey Top Workplace 2026 recognition.
